summary: Processa Pharmaceuticals acquired Vidya Therapeutics via a two-step merger on July 28, 2026, with Merger Sub I merging into Vidya, then Vidya merging into Merger Sub II. Consideration comprised 558,398 common shares and 142,744.100 Series A Non-Voting Convertible Preferred shares, each convertible into 1,000 common shares pending stockholder approval. The transaction is intended to be tax-free. Vidya became a wholly owned subsidiary. Processa issued convertible preferred stock, creating potential dilution subject to stockholder approval. Watch for stockholder vote on the conversion proposal and post-merger integration.
